verdict.rationale: The only programmatic catalog enumeration in the evidence is the `llama-model list` command in the official llama-models CLI, which an agent could shell out to. There is no documented HTTP models endpoint, and probes for an OpenAPI spec on llama.com all returned 404. Missing for 10: a documented REST/HTTP models-listing endpoint, a live (server-side) catalog rather than a CLI listing, machine-readable API spec, and hands-on corroboration of agent use.
